{"code": "from collections import Counter

# Re-check premises
print("Checking premises:")
print(f"'new' segment exists: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")
print(f"'paid_search' channel exists: {df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"'converted' is binary: {df['converted'].unique()}")
print(f"'refunded' status exists: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Confirm that we are only counting 'completed' orders for conversion
completed_count = len(df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['status'] == 'completed')])
refunded_count = len(df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['status'] == 'refunded')])

print(f"Completed orders (new + paid_search): {completed_count}")
print(f"Refunded orders (new + paid_search): {refunded_count}")
print(f"Total orders (new + paid_search): {completed_count + refunded_count}")

# Final calculation
filtered_df = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
n_total = len(filtered_df)
n_converted = filtered_df['converted'].sum()
fraction = n_converted / n_total if n_total > 0 else 0.0

print(f"Final fraction: {fraction:.4f}")"}
